subject: Working grant: application received
body:
Dear Jane Roe,

We have received your application for the City of Eastmoor working grant. Decisions are announced in mid-December.

Culture Office

subject: Paper Mill Residency 2027: you have been selected
body:
Dear Jane,

We are happy to offer you the residency from 1 to 28 February 2027. Please confirm by 1 November.

The Paper Mill team

subject: Glasshouse Painting Prize: results
body:
Dear applicant,

Thank you for entering. This year's shortlist has been chosen, and your work was not selected.

Glasshouse Gallery

subject: Materials grant: short conversation?
body:
Dear Jane,

You are on our shortlist. Could you join a 20-minute call next week to talk about your materials budget?

Weavers' Guild

subject: Working grant: a question about your budget
body:
Dear Jane Roe,

The panel asks whether the studio rent in your budget is per month or per year. A one-line answer is enough.

Culture Office
